title: Therapeutic potential of Oxalis corniculata in circumventing Alzheimer's disease through in vitro and in silico investigations.
authors: Yadav, Varsha; Das, Sinchan; Murmu, Anjali; Matore, Balaji Wamanrao; Satpathy, Swaha; Mandal, Vivekananda; Roy, Partha Pratim; Singh, Jagadish; Patra, Arjun
one_liner_zh: 该研究探讨酢浆草提取物通过抗氧化和胆碱酯酶抑制治疗阿尔茨海默病，分子对接仅针对小分子与酶受体，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a neurodegenerative disease wherein loss of memory and cognition is very common. Oxidative stress, lack of acetylcholine, and inflammation in brain tissues are characteristics of AD. Development of natural remedies such as medicinal plants for management of AD is a viable strategy. AIM OF THE STUDY: In the present study, methanolic extract of Oxalis corniculata (MEOC) was examined for its beneficial role in management of AD by integrating in vitro and in silico experiments. MATERIALS AND METHODS: MEOC was prepared from the leaves of O. corniculata, analyzed for total phenolic and flavonoid content, and subjected to GCMS and LC/MS-MS analyses for identification of various chemical compounds. The identified compounds were screened for antioxidant and cholinesterase inhibition potential by molecular docking analysis. In vitro antioxidant activity by free radical scavenging assay (DPPH assay), acetylcholinesterase (AChE) inhibition, and cytotoxicity in SHSY-5Y cells by MTT assay, of MEOC was evaluated. Furthermore, measurement of reactive oxygen species (ROS), NF-kB inhibition, level of glutathione, superoxide dismutase (SOD), malonaldehyde (MDA) and catalase in MEOC treated Lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-stimulated SHSY-5Y cells was also determined. RESULTS: MEOC contained 41.22 mg of GAE/g and 82.12 mg of QE/g of MEOC of total phenolics and flavonoids, respectively. GCMS analysis revealed the presence of 48 compounds in MEOC, and LC/MS-MS analysis confirmed the presence of 18 phenolic acids and 15 flavonoids. MEOC did not show significant neurotoxicity in SHSY-5Y cells up to a dose of 1200 mug/mL but possessed prominent antioxidant and acetylcholinesterase inhibition property. MEOC significantly reduced the level of ROS, NF-kB and MDA, however, the level of glutathione, SOD and catalase increased significantly in LPS-stimulated SHSY-5Y cells. Molecular docking studies were performed against the targets 4EY7 (AChE receptor), 4TPK (butyrylcholinesterase, BuChE receptor), and 2BXK (antioxidant receptor). Among the compounds identified through GC-MS analysis, squalene exhibited the highest docking scores across all targeted proteins. In contrast, among the flavonoids identified by LC-MS, rutin showed the strongest binding affinities toward the active sites of 4EY7 and 4TPK, with LibDock scores of 144.525 and 148.499, respectively, whereas myricetin recorded the highest docking score (125.097) against 2BXK. Among the phenolic acids identified by LC-MS, chlorogenic acid exhibited the highest binding affinities for AChE and BuChE, with docking scores of 130.868 (4EY7) and 125.387 (4TPK), respectively, while ferulic acid showed the strongest binding affinity toward the antioxidant receptor 2BXK. CONCLUSION: The findings indicate that MEOC is a rich source of phytoconstituents having antioxidant and cholinesterase inhibitory properties and may be useful in circumventing AD. It can be concluded that the leafy vegetable, O. corniculata is beneficial in AD and may be explored in the future for its mechanism of action through in vivo studies.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：阿尔茨海默病（Alzheimer's disease, AD）是一种神经退行性疾病，其中记忆和认知丧失非常常见。脑组织中的氧化应激、乙酰胆碱缺乏和炎症是AD的特征。开发天然疗法，如药用植物用于AD的管理，是一种可行的策略。研究目的：在本研究中，通过整合体外和计算机模拟实验，考察了酢浆草（Oxalis corniculata）甲醇提取物（MEOC）在AD管理中的有益作用。材料与方法：从O. corniculata叶片制备MEOC，分析其总酚和总黄酮含量，并通过GCMS和LC/MS-MS分析鉴定各种化合物。通过分子对接分析筛选所鉴定化合物的抗氧化和胆碱酯酶抑制潜力。评估了MEOC的体外抗氧化活性（通过自由基清除实验，DPPH实验）、乙酰胆碱酯酶（AChE）抑制活性，以及通过MTT实验在SHSY-5Y细胞中的细胞毒性。此外，还测定了MEOC处理脂多糖（LPS）刺激的SHSY-5Y细胞中活性氧（ROS）、NF-kB抑制、谷胱甘肽水平、超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）、丙二醛（MDA）和过氧化氢酶的水平。结果：MEOC中总酚和总黄酮含量分别为41.22 mg GAE/g和82.12 mg QE/g的MEOC。GCMS分析显示MEOC中存在48种化合物，LC/MS-MS分析确认存在18种酚酸和15种黄酮类化合物。MEOC在高达1200 μg/mL的剂量下未在SHSY-5Y细胞中显示显著神经毒性，但具有显著的抗氧化和乙酰胆碱酯酶抑制特性。MEOC显著降低了LPS刺激的SHSY-5Y细胞中ROS、NF-kB和MDA的水平，然而，谷胱甘肽、SOD和过氧化氢酶的水平显著增加。针对靶点4EY7（AChE受体）、4TPK（丁酰胆碱酯酶，BuChE受体）和2BXK（抗氧化受体）进行了分子对接研究。在通过GC-MS分析鉴定的化合物中，角鲨烯在所有靶蛋白中表现出最高的对接分数。相比之下，在通过LC-MS鉴定的黄酮类化合物中，芦丁对4EY7和4TPK活性位点表现出最强的结合亲和力，LibDock分数分别为144.525和148.499，而杨梅素对2BXK记录了最高对接分数（125.097）。在通过LC-MS鉴定的酚酸中，绿原酸对AChE和BuChE表现出最高的结合亲和力，对接分数分别为130.868（4EY7）和125.387（4TPK），而阿魏酸对抗氧化受体2BXK表现出最强的结合亲和力。结论：研究结果表明，MEOC是富含具有抗氧化和胆碱酯酶抑制特性的植物成分的来源，可能有助于规避AD。可以得出结论，叶菜类植物O. corniculata对AD有益，未来可通过体内研究探索其作用机制。
